settings.shared-effect: Steam windows and the overlay are shared. Opening from this widget uses its applied layout for that overlay session; later settings changes apply on the next opening.
settings.custom-layout-description: Let a Hyprland custom Lua layout tile the windows instead of floating+positioning them. Requires Hyprland 0.55+ Lua config and steam-layout.lua (see README). When enabled, the width sliders below are handled by the Lua layout.
